# Code of Conduct

## Expected Behavior

Treat each other with respect.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to conversations in this repository's issues and pull requests.

## Enforcement

The community leader responsible for enforcement and final authority is [Ryu](https://github.com/ryuapp).

If the community leader responsible for enforcement determines that someone has acted without respect, they may issue a warning, temporarily suspend participation, or permanently ban that person from the project.
